detail: Delete the qualified/preview tier vocabulary from every surface, per the founder's standing rule (third statement): no quality tiers anywhere, delete the concept, never rename it. The compatibility validator no longer derives a per-target level. It records absent evidence as named facts (evidenceGaps) in the validation surfaces only. The README platforms block, the docs/compatibility.md table, and the SUPPORT.md claim list every declared target uniformly: 21 targets, one support claim. test_check.py now asserts that no generated surface contains the words qualified or preview. Hand-written passages in docs/compatibility.md, docs/1.0-migration.md, docs/decisions/surface-decisions.md, the CHANGELOG 1.0.0 entry, and one oracle.rs doc comment lost the tier wording. The README is also rewritten to be succinct: the loop, the use cases, the four properties, install, SDKs, platforms, documentation, in Simplified Technical English. Evidence enforcement is unchanged: native gates, release evidence directories, field benchmarks, and the exact-commit provenance checks all still gate as before.
